description: Source code for a class that configures and transforms responses for an OpenAI-like chat completion API, including handling JSON mode conversion, usage sanitization, and parameter mapping.

classes.name: OpenAILikeChatConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for OpenAI-like chat completion, including response transformation and parameter mapping.

methods.name: _get_openai_compatible_provider_info
methods.description: Retrieves API base URL and API key, using secrets if not provided.

methods.name: _json_mode_convert_tool_response_to_message
methods.description: Converts tool call responses to JSON content in message when json_mode is enabled.

methods.name: _sanitize_usage_obj
methods.description: Replaces null token counts in usage object with zero for compatibility.

methods.name: _transform_response
methods.description: Processes the HTTP response, sanitizes data, converts messages if in JSON mode, and constructs a ModelResponse.

methods.name: transform_response
methods.description: Public method that calls the static _transform_response with parameters.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps and adjusts openai parameters, replacing max_completion_tokens with max_tokens if needed.
